signature.summary: A teardrop of glossy blue gel that bounces everywhere it goes. The first monster most players fight: cute, readable, and slightly sneaky (Engulf).
idle: Breathing wobble: core scales 1.00→1.04→1.00 over 90 f (blend shape 'puff' 0→0.15).
Every 4–7 s a 'look around' hop in place: 0.15 m high, lands with squash 0.35 for 4 f then overshoots to stretch 0.1.
Eyes blink 18×/min (Charming); highlight on the crown rotates slowly toward the sun.
movement: Hop gait: anticipation squash 0.4 (6 f) → launch stretch 0.5 (2 f) → airborne roundness (8 f) → land squash 0.5 (4 f) → settle wobble via lobe springs (8 f). One hop covers 0.6 m at refSize.
Turns happen mid-air only (no ground pivot), so it 'faces' you between hops.
On slopes it slides 0.2 m after landing (gel friction 0.3).
combat: Body Slam (blue): squash low 10 f (telegraph flash on frame 4) → leaps on a 1 m arc → lands on target with a splash ring. Hitbox = core sphere during the last 4 f of the arc and the landing frame.

Engulf (gold grab): only if the player stands still within 1.2 m for 1.5 s. The slime spreads into a puddle (blend 'squash' 1.0 + scale XY 1.6) for 18 f, then rises around the player. Mash/dodge escapes; damage over time inside.
Split (higher tiers only): on death above E rank it pinches in two (blend 'split_pinch'), spawning two mini slimes at 0.5× size with 20% HP.
Tide Lash: a lobe stretches into a 1.2 m whip (lobe_front spring stiffness drops to 0.05 for the swing) and snaps back.
hitReact: Light hit: squash toward the hit direction 0.3 + jiggle impulse on all lobes; slides back 0.3 m.
Heavy hit: flattens like a pancake for 6 f, then pops back with a 'boing' (stretch 0.4 overshoot).
Launched: becomes a perfect sphere, spins slowly; on landing it bounces once (restitution 0.4).
signature.death: Pops: squash 1.0 for 3 f, then the mesh is replaced by a splash VFX + gel puddle decal that evaporates in 4 s. The Gel Core drops from the inner_item bone position.
blender: Model one smooth dome (≈1,200 tris) with the inner Gel Core as a separate object parented to inner_item.
Shape keys: squash (Z ×0.5, XY ×1.35, keep volume), stretch (Z ×1.5, XY ×0.82), puff, blink_L/R, smile, frown, split_pinch.
Weight lobes with soft falloff (radius 0.35) so the springs read as jelly, not bones.
unity: Material: toon shader with refraction fake (matcap) + rim light; inner item visible through 30% transparency.
Add SquashStretch (velocity → squash/stretch blend shapes) and SpringChain on the four lobes + crown.
Collider: sphere; Rigidbody optional (NavMeshAgent drives it, hops are root motion).

signature.summary: A heavier, cloudier slime with leaves and twigs caught inside. Slower than the Blue Slime, sticks to surfaces.
idle: Slower breathing (120 f). Debris inside drifts with the inner_item wobble.
Occasionally 'tastes' the ground: flattens 0.2 and leaves a sticky decal.
movement: Crawls more than it hops (ooze_crawl 70% / hop 30%). Crawl: a wave runs front→back through the lobes (phase 0.25 each).
Can climb walls slowly (canClimb walls_slow): aligns its base to the surface normal.
combat: Sticky spit: a glob arcs 4 m and leaves a slowing puddle for 5 s.
Body slam like the Blue Slime but 20% slower windup and larger splash.
hitReact: Hits leave a dent that fills back over 20 f (blend 'squash' localized via a dent shape key).
signature.death: Melts into a green puddle that stays sticky for 3 s (slows the player).
blender: Same dome as the Blue Slime, 10% wider at the base; debris as 3 small separate meshes parented to inner_item.
unity: Opacity 70%; debris uses its own wobble spring (stiffness 0.2).

signature.summary: Hunched, wiry, all elbows and grin. Fights in packs of 3–5: one attacks while the others feint, circle and throw junk. Cowardly alone, brave in groups.
idle: Shifts weight foot to foot every 2–3 s; scratches ear (ear springs flick).
Looks at nearby goblins before acting (head look-at swaps between packmates and the player).
Spins its crude blade in the hand (weapon bone rotates 360° over 20 f) as a fidget.
movement: Walk: knees bent 25°, spine hunched 20° forward, arms swing wide and low.
Run: leans 35° forward; above 70% of run speed it drops to all fours (sprint_all_fours) for a burst.
Circling: strafes at the pack's preferred range (≈3.5 m) with a bouncy side-step, blade pointed at you.
Retreat: backpedals with tiny quick steps, then turns and runs when HP < 25% to call others (vocal 'call').
combat: Stab (blue, parryable): 12 f windup with the blade pulled back to the hip (telegraph frame 4), 4 f thrust with a 0.8 m lunge, 15 f recovery stumble (the punish window).
Thrown Junk (projectile): rummages in its pouch 15 f, throws an arc (rock, bottle, bone) 6–10 m; random prop each time.
Frenzied Lunge (red, unblockable, low HP only): screeches, then 3 wild slashes over 30 f while hopping forward 2.5 m. Dodge only.
Pack rule: only 2 goblins hold aggro tokens; the rest feint (half-lunge, cancel at frame 8) and taunt (taunt clip) to keep pressure readable.
hitReact: Light hit: head snaps back, ears flop (spring impulse), says 'ack!'.
Heavy hit: spins 180° and lands on its backside, then scrambles up (getup 36 f).
Launched: flails all four limbs (additive flail layer) — very funny, very readable.
Disarmed (weapon part broken): fights with claws and bites (swap to claw moveset).
signature.death: Full ragdoll with a 'last gasp' pose for 6 f before ragdoll; the blade drops separately as a physics prop.
blender: Proportions: head 30% of height, hands 1.4× human scale, feet long and flat. Ears are 2-bone spring chains.
Separate meshes for blade, pouch and loincloth (cloth: 1 spring chain or Unity cloth).
Humanoid naming so Mixamo clips retarget; author unique attacks by hand.
unity: Humanoid avatar; use Mixamo 'crouched walk' as a base then layer the hunch with an Avatar Mask (spine + head).
Aggro tokens: see AggroTokens in Ascend.Core (max 2 attackers).

signature.summary: Stays at the back of the pack on high ground; shoots, then repositions. Flees from melee.
idle: Tests the bowstring (small twang) and squints down range.
movement: Prefers range 10–14 m; after every 2 shots it relocates to a new spot (cover or high ground).
If the player closes to 3 m it hops back twice (dodge_back) and draws a knife.
combat: Aimed shot (blue): 24 f draw with a visible arrow glint (telegraph), releases on frame 24; leads the target by 0.3 s of the player's velocity.
Volley (red, rare): 3 arrows in a fan after a 36 f draw.
hitReact: Drops the bow on a heavy hit 30% of the time (must pick it up: 40 f).
signature.death: Ragdoll; the bow breaks into 2 pieces on impact.
blender: Bow is a separate prop on weapon_L with its own 2-bone string (or a shape key for draw).
unity: Upper-body aim offset layer (aim_offset_upper_body) so it can shoot while strafing.

signature.summary: Sneaky goblin that lays snares and caltrops, then lures you into them.
idle: Fiddles with a bear trap; low crouch.
movement: Moves crouched along walls; places a trap (20 f kneel) when you lose sight of it.
Backs away toward its traps when fighting.
combat: Snare toss (gold): throws a weighted net; caught players must mash free.
Caltrop scatter: a quick throw that covers a 3 m cone with slowing spikes.
hitReact: Panics if hit while placing a trap and may trigger its own trap (10% chance, comedic).
signature.death: Ragdoll; drops unused traps that the player can pick up.
blender: Extra pouches and a rolled net prop on the back (spring chain for the net).
unity: Traps are separate prefabs with trigger colliders.

signature.summary: Bone-masked goblin with a staff of feathers. Buffs the pack and throws curse orbs. The cult runes appear on it first.
idle: Shakes the staff rhythmically; feathers on the staff are spring chains.
movement: Stays 6–8 m behind the pack; hops backward when approached.
combat: Curse orb (blue, magic): 30 f chant with rising rune circle, orb travels 8 m/s.
Frenzy dance (buff, interruptable): 45 f dance that gives nearby goblins +20% speed. Hitting it during the dance cancels it (stagger).
hitReact: Mask slips on a heavy hit, revealing a scared face (blend shape 'fear').
signature.death: Ragdoll; the staff stands upright in the ground for 3 s, glowing, then falls.
blender: Bone mask as a separate rigid mesh on the head bone; staff with 3 feather spring chains.
unity: Rune circle VFX attached to the root during chants.

signature.summary: A goblin that grew into a soldier: upright, armored, disciplined. Leads packs and fights with shield and club.
idle: Stands straight (unlike goblins); taps its club on the shield; barks orders (vocal) to nearby goblins.
movement: Walks with a measured, heavy step; shield always toward the player.
Signals the pack: points with the club, and goblins move to flank (sets the pack's flank angle).
combat: Shield bash (blue): 14 f lean-in, 0.8 m shove, staggers the player on hit.
Overhead club (red if charged): 20 f raise, 6 f smash, ground crack decal.
Guard: blocks frontal light hits (block_loop) until its shield breaks.
hitReact: Frontal light hits are blocked (spark VFX) unless the shield part is broken.
signature.death: Kneels first (16 f), then ragdoll forward onto the shield.
blender: Armor plates as rigid pieces parented to chest/upperarm bones (no skin deformation on metal).
unity: Shield is a breakable part (partId 'shield', bone weapon_L).

signature.summary: The classic rookie killer: a fluffy rabbit with a spiral horn that charges in a straight line when cornered. Cute until it isn't.
idle: Nose twitch loop (blend 'nose_twitch', 8 Hz in bursts of 1 s).
Sits up to listen every 5–8 s (sit_up_listen); ears rotate toward the loudest sound (ear springs + look-at).
Grooms a paw (eat_loop variant).
movement: Hops in bursts of 2–4, then freezes for 0.5–1.5 s (prey behaviour).
Bound gait when fleeing: very fast, zig-zags every 0.6 s (±35°).
Thump warning: stamps a hind foot (thump_warning) before a charge; the sound is the real telegraph.
combat: Charge (red, unblockable): thump → 18 f crouch with horn lowered (red flash) → straight-line dash 6 m at bound speed, cannot turn after frame 4 of the dash. Hits stagger the player. If it misses and hits a wall or tree, it gets stuck for 1.5 s (horn in the wood) — the big punish moment.
Bite (blue): quick 8 f nip when you're right next to it.
Leap (blue): hops 2 m at your head; weak but knocks you back.
hitReact: Squeals; flips onto its back on a heavy hit and wiggles back up (very readable).
Launched: spins with ears trailing (ear springs, gravity 0.4).
signature.death: Ragdoll tumble; ears fall last. The horn can drop intact (Horn Shard) unless it was broken.
blender: Big hind feet (hind_foot 1.5× front), round body, ears 40% of body length. Horn is a separate mesh on the head bone (breakable part 'head').
Fluff: shell-texture fur or alpha cards; keep under 2,500 tris.
unity: Charge uses root motion with tracking 0 after the dash starts.
Stuck-in-tree state: a trigger on the horn tip detects walls/trees.

signature.summary: Grey wolves in packs of 3–4. They circle, test you with feints, and strike from behind.
idle: Sniffs the ground, ears forward; the pack leader stands taller (posture +5°).
movement: Trot circles at 4 m around the player; each wolf picks a different angle (120° apart).
Gallop to close distance, then slows to a stalk (head low, Menace 3 posture) for the last 3 m.
combat: Pounce (blue): 10 f crouch, leap 3 m, bite on landing.
Hamstring bite (blue): darts in from the side, bites, retreats in one motion.
Howl (buff): calls the pack; nearby wolves gain speed for 10 s.
hitReact: Yelps and skids sideways; tail tucks (tail spring gravity up briefly).
signature.death: Ragdoll slide along the ground; the pack hesitates for 2 s (morale).
blender: Mane as a 2-bone spring chain; tail 4 bones.
unity: Spine bend on turns (procedural) for tight circling.

signature.summary: A stubborn tusked boar. Scrapes the ground, then charges; turns slowly, so sidestep and hit its flank.
idle: Roots in the dirt with its snout (eat_loop) and snorts.
movement: Trots heavily; turns slowly (turn rate ×0.6 via a heavy feel).
Before a charge it scrapes a front hoof twice (paw_scrape_charge_windup) — the telegraph.
combat: Tusk charge (red): 30 f scrape → 8 m charge; can't turn after the first 0.3 s; skids for 1 s after a miss.
Tusk toss (blue): close range upward gore that launches the player.
hitReact: Barely flinches from light hits (knockback resist); heavy hits make it stumble sideways.
signature.death: Falls onto its side and kicks once.
blender: Tusks are separate meshes (breakable 'head' → Tusk). Bristles along the spine as a spring chain (mane bones).
unity: Footstep camera shake small; dust puffs on the charge.

signature.summary: Dog-sized worker ants in the old drains and fields. They swarm, carry things, and spray acid when threatened.

movement: Tripod gait (legs 1L,2R,3L then 1R,2L,3R) with procedural IK; walks on walls and ceilings.

combat: Mandible snap (blue): rears up 8 f, snaps.
Acid spray (blue): curls the abdomen forward (12 f), sprays a 3 m cone.
hitReact: Legs splay and it slides; on heavy hits it flips onto its back for 1.5 s (big punish).
signature.death: Flips over, legs curl in over 20 f.
blender: Rigid chitin pieces per segment (no skin deformation); legs are rigid segments too.
unity: Wall walking: align the root to the surface normal; gravity follows the surface.

Abdomen pulses slowly (breathing).

hitReact: Legs fold in for a moment, then it skitters back.
signature.death: Flips, legs curl.
blender: 8 legs as rigid segments; abdomen weighted softly for the pulse spring.

signature.summary: Slow, relentless, wrong. Shambles on the north road at night. Grabs if you let it get close.
idle: Sways in place, head lolling (spring on the neck via an additive layer); sometimes twitches.
movement: Shamble: one leg drags (left foot IK lags 0.2 s), speed 0.8 m/s; lurches 2 m suddenly when the player is within 4 m.
Turns its head before its body (Dread-like) even at Menace 3.
combat: Grab (gold): arms raise for 18 f, lunges 1 m; caught players take bite damage until they break free.
Swipe (blue): slow wide arm swing.
hitReact: Barely reacts to light hits (only the hit part jerks — additive per-bone reactions); heavy hits knock it down, and it gets up in an unnatural way (getup played at 0.7× with joints bending backward).
signature.death: Collapses like strings were cut (instant ragdoll, no death pose).
blender: Torn clothing as spring/cloth; one arm slightly longer (asymmetry).
Rot: vertex color mask for a 'decay' shader.
unity: Per-bone additive hit reactions (procedural) instead of full-body flinches.

signature.summary: Clattering skeleton soldiers. Light, fast, fall apart when hit hard — and put themselves back together.
idle: Jaw clacks; skull tilts at you curiously.
movement: Brisk march with a clattering rhythm; bones rattle (tiny procedural jitter on limbs).
combat: Sword slash (blue), shield block, and a desperate bone throw (it throws its own arm).
hitReact: Heavy hits make it collapse into a pile of bones (physics) for 3 s, then reassemble (reassemble clip, bones fly back). Light/holy damage during the pile destroys it for good.
signature.death: Bones scatter as physics pieces; the skull rolls.
blender: Each bone mesh rigidly parented to its bone (no skinning) so it can come apart as separate rigidbodies.
unity: Death and collapse: unparent the bone meshes into Rigidbodies; reassemble by lerping them back over 1 s.

signature.summary: Millbrook's first horror. It's in a different field every night. It never moves while you watch it.
idle: Hangs on its post, arms out, head tilted. Burlap face with a stitched smile.
movement: Freeze when observed: if it's in the camera view and not occluded, it doesn't move at all.

unity: FreezeWhenObserved component (camera frustum + occlusion raycast).
SteppedAnimator at 8 fps when moving.
